content_of_post_to_comment:
in these last 3 months i have lost everything. i had an ex evict me after i told him something about my past, with that i had to scramble for rent and ended up in a room which the male landlord is now threatening after i rejected advances. lost a job last month due to the same reason. i gave up my kitten, hopefully temporarily, yesterday as the house is infested with fleas. somehow i am still sober but i am afraid this is the "karma" my ex warned would bite me due to me "ruining us". the only hope ive got is for a few treatment center based jobs where onboarding is in progress, its something ive wanted to do for a while.

23, 2 years into complete abstinence and i dont have a car, dont have steady income just yet, am in a state with no family. looking for housing is brutal as 1/2 of the inquiries i get are men trying to trade housing for sex. my room is infested with ants and dont feel safe in this bed anymore. i dont want to believe that taking a stranger up on such an offer is my only way out.

i can see that getting through this will make me all the more grateful when i achieve complete independence and have a safe place to sleep. but it feels impossible to build up without stability. i still have debt to clear in order to go to college, still have little evidence that i can actually survive this earth without relying on a man. im very afraid and need some guidance.
comment: The fact that you’re still sober after losing housing, work, and your sense of safety says a lot about the strength you’ve already built. Also, please don’t let your ex’s “karma” comment become the story you use to explain this. Bad things happening doesn’t mean you deserve them. The housing-for-sex situation is exploitation, not your only option. Are there local women’s shelters, recovery communities, or transitional housing programs you’ve contacted?
